events.title: 10/18/2026 Demo Update Patch Notes
events.summary: 10/18/2026 Demo Update Patch NotesAdjusted volume of all background musicMade it so NPCs can be interrupted and talked to mid angry/laugh reactAdjusted Fun Police proximity detection to allow players to sneak more closely behind them without being detectedFixed a bug causing the badge counter to display the wrong number of found badgesFixed a bug causing the player portrait's animations to get interruptedFixed a bug where Fun Police could be alerted mid slipping animationOther misc bug fixes

events.title: 10/13/2026 Demo Update 2 Patch Notes
events.summary: 10/13/2026 Demo Update 2 Patch NotesFixed a bug where the player could in a specific location be pushed outside map boundaries by moving level geometryFixed a bug where the player could become softlocked in a secret areaFixed a bug causing the player to get caught on invisible seams in the level geometryOther misc bug fixes

events.title: 10/13/2026 Demo Update Patch Notes
events.summary: 10/13/2026 Demo Update Patch NotesFixed a bug that would cause the water flower effect to continue playing indefinitely even when not equippedFixed an oversight that would allow clever players to get outside of the mapFixed a bug where bombs would damage NPCs through wallsOther misc bug fixes

events.title: 10/10/2026 Demo Update Patch Notes
events.summary: 10/10/2026 Demo Update Patch NotesAdjusted player visibility when crouched so guards can't see the player from as far awayFixed a bug where guards could be alerted during the respawn sequenceFixed problems with the HUD scaling incorrectly at some resolutionsOther misc bug fixes

events.title: 10/8/2026 Demo Update Patch Notes
events.summary: 10/08/2026 Demo Update Patch NotesFixed a bug where respawning while on a ladder would teleport the player to the wrong locationFixed hitches while loading levelsOther misc bug fixes

events.title: 10/7/2026 Demo Update Patch Notes
events.summary: 10/07/2026 Demo Update Patch NotesAdded Invert Mouse X and Invert Mouse Y optionsMisc tweaks to Party Crasher levelFixed a bug in the camera controller causing occasional stutteringFixed a bug causing audio to stop working under specific circumstancesOther misc bug fixes

events.title: 10/6/2026 Demo Update Patch Notes
events.summary: 10/05/2026 Demo Update Patch NotesFixed a bug where the figurine key item name and description weren't being displayed properlyTweaked the Well Well Well bonus objective for better clarityOther misc bug fixes

events.title: 10/5/2026 Demo Update Patch Notes
events.summary: 10/05/2026 Demo Update Patch NotesFixed a bug where an NPCs schedule change could get triggered from the wrong actionFixed a bug with NPC's AI causing degraded performance after long play timesFixed a bug where the player could get stuck behind a barrel with the Short King badge equippedOther miscellaneous fixes and small performance improvements
